en:
What are you doing here?
Shouldn't you be at the dining hall?

I was just on my way there...
Um...

...Ah, it's nothing. The others are probably
waiting for us. We should go.

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's up with Shuichi?
He seems preoccupied with something...

<CLT=cltMIND>Well, I can ask him later.
I need to go.

<CLT=cltMIND>I don't think it's good to stare at the
boys bathroom...right?

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us...
But there's nothing displayed right now.
